BiblicalUsage: The word names sickness, and it is used for the diseases of Egypt and the prayers of kings. God promises Israel that if they hearken to His voice He will put none of the diseases of Egypt upon them, for He is the LORD that heals them, and He will take sickness away from their midst. Solomon prays that whatever plague or sickness comes upon the land, God would hear from heaven, and the proverb says the spirit of a man will sustain his infirmity, but a wounded spirit who can bear.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sickness is in God's hands, because He sends it and He heals it, and the prayer of a king is heard from heaven. I hold that the body can bear much when the spirit is whole, and the wounded spirit is the sickness no physician can reach.
